"""Process Awesome-Agent-Papers.pptx:
1. Detect dangling paper titles.
2. Change font to Arial 16, color #989596, disable bold.
3. Adjust box width so title fits one line.
4. Center-bottom position.
5. Add a Reference slide at the end with auto-numbered bullets of unique titles.
"""
from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Pt, Emu, Inches
from pptx.dml.color import RGBColor
from pptx.enum.text import PP_ALIGN
from pptx.oxml.ns import qn
from copy import deepcopy
from PIL import ImageFont
import os

INPUT = "/root/Awesome-Agent-Papers.pptx"
OUTPUT = "/root/Awesome-Agent-Papers_processed.pptx"

prs = Presentation(INPUT)
slide_w = prs.slide_width  # EMU
slide_h = prs.slide_height

# Try to load an Arial font for width measurement; fall back to default
def find_font(size_pt):
    candidates = [
        "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/msttcorefonts/Arial.ttf",
        "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/liberation/LiberationSans-Regular.ttf",
        "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf",
    ]
    for p in candidates:
        if os.path.exists(p):
            return ImageFont.truetype(p, size=size_pt)
    return ImageFont.load_default()

# Font width is in pixels for a given point size; we use 72 DPI assumption so px == pt.
font = find_font(16)

def text_width_inches(text):
    # width in points (approx) -> inches
    bbox = font.getbbox(text)
    width_pt = bbox[2] - bbox[0]
    return width_pt / 72.0

def is_title_placeholder(shape):
    if not shape.has_text_frame:
        return False
    if not shape.is_placeholder:
        return False
    try:
        return shape.placeholder_format.idx == 0 or "TITLE" in str(shape.placeholder_format.type)
    except Exception:
        return False

def is_body_placeholder(shape):
    if not shape.is_placeholder:
        return False
    try:
        t = str(shape.placeholder_format.type)
        return "BODY" in t or "OBJECT" in t or "CONTENT" in t
    except Exception:
        return False

GRAY = RGBColor(0x98, 0x95, 0x96)

paper_titles_ordered = []  # preserve first-appearance order; dedup later

for slide_idx, slide in enumerate(prs.slides):
    if slide_idx == 0:
        continue  # cover slide

    # dangling paper title shapes = text shapes that are not TITLE or BODY/OBJECT placeholders
    for shape in list(slide.shapes):
        if not shape.has_text_frame:
            continue
        if is_title_placeholder(shape):
            continue
        if is_body_placeholder(shape):
            continue

        tf = shape.text_frame
        text = tf.text.strip()
        if not text:
            continue

        # Apply formatting: Arial, 16pt, color #989596, no bold
        for p in tf.paragraphs:
            for run in p.runs:
                run.font.name = "Arial"
                run.font.size = Pt(16)
                run.font.bold = False
                run.font.color.rgb = GRAY

        # Adjust width to fit on one line (add a little padding)
        w_in = text_width_inches(text) + 0.3
        new_width_emu = Inches(w_in)
        # don't exceed slide width minus small margin
        max_w = slide_w - Inches(0.2)
        if new_width_emu > max_w:
            new_width_emu = max_w
        shape.width = int(new_width_emu)

        # Fit height snugly (one line of 16pt ~ 0.33"); add some margin
        shape.height = Inches(0.5)

        # Horizontally center and place at bottom
        shape.left = int((slide_w - shape.width) / 2)
        bottom_margin = Inches(0.3)
        shape.top = int(slide_h - shape.height - bottom_margin)

        # Record paper title
        paper_titles_ordered.append(text)

# Dedupe preserving order
seen = set()
unique_titles = []
for t in paper_titles_ordered:
    if t not in seen:
        seen.add(t)
        unique_titles.append(t)

# Add Reference slide at end using "Title and Content" layout if available
ref_layout = None
for layout in prs.slide_layouts:
    if layout.name and "Title and Content" in layout.name:
        ref_layout = layout
        break
if ref_layout is None:
    # fallback: pick a layout that has a body placeholder; typically index 1
    ref_layout = prs.slide_layouts[1] if len(prs.slide_layouts) > 1 else prs.slide_layouts[0]

ref_slide = prs.slides.add_slide(ref_layout)

# set title
if ref_slide.shapes.title is not None:
    ref_slide.shapes.title.text = "Reference"

# find the body placeholder
body_ph = None
for shape in ref_slide.placeholders:
    if shape.placeholder_format.idx != 0 and shape.has_text_frame:
        body_ph = shape
        break

if body_ph is None:
    # add a textbox as fallback
    body_ph = ref_slide.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(0.5), Inches(1.8), Inches(12.3), Inches(5.4))

tf = body_ph.text_frame
tf.clear()
tf.word_wrap = True

# Helper: set paragraph to be a numbered (Arabic) auto-numbered bullet at level 0
def set_auto_numbered(paragraph):
    pPr = paragraph._pPr
    if pPr is None:
        pPr = paragraph._p.get_or_add_pPr()
    # remove any existing bullet elements
    for tag in ("a:buChar", "a:buNone", "a:buAutoNum"):
        for el in pPr.findall(qn(tag)):
            pPr.remove(el)
    bu = pPr.makeelement(qn("a:buAutoNum"), {"type": "arabicPeriod"})
    pPr.append(bu)
    pPr.set("indent", "-342900")
    pPr.set("marL", "342900")

for i, title in enumerate(unique_titles):
    if i == 0:
        p = tf.paragraphs[0]
    else:
        p = tf.add_paragraph()
    p.text = title
    p.level = 0
    set_auto_numbered(p)

prs.save(OUTPUT)
print(f"Saved to {OUTPUT}")
print(f"Unique papers ({len(unique_titles)}):")
for t in unique_titles:
    print(" -", t)
